headline: Accellera forms the SystemVerilog Mixed-Signal Interface Types Working Group
fact: Accellera formed the SystemVerilog Mixed-Signal Interface Types Working Group to define SystemVerilog-compatible interconnect, conversion and resolution among dissimilar net types, including bidirectional connections between logic or user-defined nets and analog, electrical or real signals. Accellera said work in the UVM-MS and SystemVerilog-AMS groups had exposed a fundamental need for this capability within IEEE 1800 and that earlier approaches outside IEEE 1800, such as Verilog-AMS connect modules, had not met the complexity and usability requirements of typical SoCs. Peter Grove was named co-chair of the new working group.

sources.title: Accellera Forms SystemVerilog Mixed-Signal Interface Types Working Group
sources.summary: Accellera's February 7, 2024 formation announcement defines the bidirectional mixed-net scope, links the need to UVM-MS and SystemVerilog-AMS work, describes limitations of prior connect-module approaches, and names Peter Grove as co-chair.

sources.title: SystemVerilog Mixed-Signal Interface Types Working Group
sources.summary: The current Accellera working-group page preserves the charter and scope for uni- and bidirectional connections among logic, UDN, analog, electrical and real signals.
